offering_description.value: Regulated natural gas utility delivering gas to homes and businesses in New Jersey, plus clean energy project development, natural gas storage and transport services, and home appliance service plans. Sells through company-owned pipelines, storage assets and customer service programs.

primary_products.value: natural gas; solar power; fuel cell power; home appliance service plans

primary_services.value: natural gas delivery; natural gas storage and transportation; energy asset management; appliance repair; energy efficiency installation

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential homeowners and renters in New Jersey buying gas and appliance service plans; B2B: commercial and industrial gas customers, wholesale energy buyers, solar project offtakers

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial and industrial energy; power generation; utilities

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: regulated gas delivery charges billed to utility customers based on usage; product sales: natural gas sold to customers and wholesale energy buyers; service fees: home appliance service plans and repair fees paid by homeowners; project or contract: solar, fuel cell and energy efficiency projects built under contract
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs gas distribution pipelines, storage facilities and solar assets; distributor: buys natural gas from suppliers and delivers it to residential and business customers; service provider: takes in service fees and sells appliance repair and energy services to homeowners

geography_served.value: US regional: New Jersey, mainly Monmouth and Ocean counties, some clean energy projects in other eastern US states

specialization.value: diversified: natural gas utility, clean energy ventures, energy services and home services businesses

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: energy sales and service plans sold directly to residential and business customers; online: online account management and bill payment for utility customers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: gas distribution rates and service set by the New Jersey Board of Public Utilities, FERC rules for pipelines and storage
